title: Power Rangers Season 9 Time Force
description: Power Rangers Time Force is a television series and the ninth season of the Power Rangers franchise, based on the 24th Super Sentai series Mirai Sentai Timeranger, running for 40 half-hour episodes from February to November 2001. It was the last season to be distributed by Saban Entertainment

episodes.title: S9-E17The Legend of the Clock Tower

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Time Force 9x1
episodes_data.description: In the year 3000 the evil mutant fugitive Ransik escapes the custody of the elite police force known as Time Force.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Time Force 9x2
episodes_data.description: Traveling back in time in pursuit of Ransik, the Time Force officers meet the distant ancestor of their former leader.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Time Force 9x3
episodes_data.description: Wes weighs his privileged lifestyle against the responsibilities of joining the Power Rangers Time Force as the new Red Ranger.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Time Force 9x4
episodes_data.description: Ransik kidnaps Wes and takes over a television station to announce his evil plans to the world.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Time Force 9x5
episodes_data.description: 31st century champion racecar driver Lucas adjusts to 21st century traffic laws as Trip develops new Vector Cycles for the Rangers.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Time Force 9x6
episodes_data.description: Ransik hijacks a bus full of school children and Wes' wealthy father refuses to pay the ransom, prompting Wes to reevaluate his place in the family.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Time Force 9x7
episodes_data.description: Realizing Circuit is the key to the Rangers summoning their Zords, Nadira plots to capture the Rangers' robotic friend.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Time Force 9x8
episodes_data.description: Jen tracks down Fatcatfish, the mutant that she's encountered before. She wants to kill Fatcatfish for personal reasons.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Time Force 9x9
episodes_data.description: Mr. Collins's company develops a new weapon, the Raimei Destroyer, an armored tank to defend itself against Ransik's attacks. But it's no match for the mutant attacks. Even the Rangers Megazord can't stand up to the latest mutant. In the future, a mysterious figure sends them the Time Shadow.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Time Force 9x10
episodes_data.description: The Rangers try to find some 21st-century weapons to help them. They discover that some technology was developed as a result of Ransik's attacks. Consequently, the future has been altered. This creates doubts for Katie who starts to question their reasons for being in this time. Meanwhile, Frax unleashes a mutant on the city. Now each Ranger must find their own motivation for stopping this latest mutant.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Time Force 9x11
episodes_data.description: Trip begins to feel like he's not contributing to the Rangers. He tries to emulate the others in battle, but ends up causing more problems. As Ransik releases a mutant who feeds off energy, Trip realizes how he helps the team in their battles, and finishes building a new weapon for the team.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Time Force 9x12
episodes_data.description: Wes' dad forms the Silver Guardians, a paramilitary squad to protect the rich from Ransik's gang of mutants.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Time Force 9x13
episodes_data.description: On a dig, some researchers discover a metallic object. As word of the discovery spreads, Ransik recognizes the object as the Quantum Controller, and unleashes a mutant to get it for him. Circuit also recognizes the object, and the Rangers try to recover the object before it falls into the wrong hands. As the Rangers fight the mutant, Eric manages to take the controller and hides it away. He then tries to become the Guardian's new leader, but is turned down. So he goes back to where the controller is. The mutant attacks again. As the Rangers fight the mutant, Wes tries to convince Eric to give up the controller, but he ignores him and activates the Quantum Controller, becoming the Quantum Ranger in the process.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Time Force 9x14
episodes_data.description: Even without the Quantum morpher, Ransik wants to possess the Quantasaurus Rex, the Quantum Ranger's megazord. He sends Commandocon to retrieve it. The Rangers try to talk Eric into giving up the morpher, but he refuses. They all witness a time portal opening, realizing that someone is after the Q-Rex, Eric summons the Eagle flyer and enters the portal. Wes jumps onto the flyer.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Time Force 9x15
episodes_data.description: In the past, they try to locate the Q-Rex. But Commandocon gets to it first, takes control of the Q-Rex and journeys back to the 21st century. Eric and Wes follow him back through the time portal. The Q-Rex is rampaging in the city. The Rangers need the Quantum Morpher to get control of the Q-Rex. While Wes tries to talk to Eric, Mr Collins makes the other Rangers an offer to join the Silver Guardians, with his company they could defeat Ransik faster. Will they join the Guardians?

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Time Force 9x16
episodes_data.description: As Dr Zaskins tries to unlock the secrets of the Quantum morpher, he is kidnapped. His daughter, Holly, manages to escape, and tries to hire Lucas as her bodyguard. Lucas is hesitant but then finds out who her father is. While the other Rangers rescue Zaskin, Lucas protects Holly.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Time Force 9x17
episodes_data.description: The Rangers try to fix the clock in the tower, but have no luck. Wes tells them about a ghost that is supposed to inhabit the tower. That night Katie hears a noise, and she investigates. She finds herself in the past, and meets the people from Wes's story. With her help, there's a different ending to the story. Then she wakes up as a mutant attacks. After the battle, she tells her friends about her dream and how the ending had changed, but Wes corrects her and says that's how he had told it, leaving her wondering if it really was a dream.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Time Force 9x18
episodes_data.description: Jen tells Wes to guard the back of a bank so the Rangers can cut off Nadira's escape route. But the Guardians show up, and Wes tries to deal with them, giving Nadira a chance to escape. Jen is upset with Wes and says that she can't trust him. Meanwhile, Turtlecon attacks and sends the Rangers to a different dimension and after a short battle with duplicate Ranger, Wes and Jen manage to escape. They have to learn to trust each other if they want to rescue their friends.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Time Force 9x19
episodes_data.description: Trip stands up to Ransik and Eric to protect a peaceful repentant mutant fugitive.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Time Force 9x20
episodes_data.description:
As researchers work on unlocking the secrets of the Quantum Morpher, Ransik releases Conwing to take control of the Q-Rex. Conwing captures Eric, takes his morpher and replicates Eric's voice, which lets him take control of the Q-Rex. Eric finds out where the morpher comes from. The Rangers show up and try to help out but Eric wants to handle it alone. He suddenly gets some help from the future and uses Mega Battle mode. Will Eric reveal the Rangers secrets?

Note: This episode is dedicated to the memory of Minoru Uchiyama, who was the costume designer and make up artist for various Super Sentai series.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Time Force 9x21
episodes_data.description: The male members of Time Force all seem to be attracted to the same girl for different reasons. When it starts to cause friction in the team, Jen orders them to stop seeing her. Hearing that Wes missed a job, Jen tracks him down and finds that he's still seeing the same girl, who it turns out is a mutant. Now it's up to Jen and Katie to free their teammates from her influence. Jen breaks the mutant's control bracelet and the Rangers capture her after quite long fight.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Time Force 9x22
episodes_data.description: Lucas has to attend traffic school after being ticketed for reckless driving (even though the others caused Lucas to be ticketed). Nadira releases Dash, a former racing champion, to be her personal driver. The Rangers arrive, Dash and Lucas recognize each other. Dash had caused a huge accident while street racing and Lucas had to testify against him. Dash challenges him to one last race. If Lucas wins, he promises to accept responsibility for his actions and turn himself in. But Nadira has other plans for him. Ultimately, Dash stops the race when he nearly causes another accident but Nadira forces him to fight. He is defeated and willingly surrenders, but asks Lucas to be the one who refreezes him, which he does.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Time Force 9x23
episodes_data.description: A photographer working for a tabloid is given a new assignment, to take pictures of the Rangers in their civilian guise. He needs help carrying his equipment and hires Katie to help him. His first attempt fails and Katie manages to warn the others. Katie sticks with him so she can keep tabs on him. Meanwhile, Artillicon attacks again and the Rangers attack backfires on them, resulting in them reverting to their civilian identities. As the photographer prepares to sell his pictures, Katie tries to talk him out of it.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Time Force 9x24
episodes_data.description: The heroes are trapped by Ransik's gang in various movie genre dimensions.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Time Force 9x25
episodes_data.description: The Rangers work to escape various movie genre dimensions.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Time Force 9x26
episodes_data.description: A former Time Force officer, Steelix, Jen's old Time Force partner, seeks revenge on Jen for getting him locked up. He steals her morpher, fights her on her own, then turns her insane. Wes breaks Jen out of the spell, and all of the Rangers defeat Steelix after the long fight.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Time Force 9x27
episodes_data.description: Frax's origin is revealed as he finally has enough of Ransik's abuse.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Time Force 9x28
episodes_data.description: The time travelers' actions in the present begin to change the future as a previously dead ally from the past returns.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Time Force 9x29
episodes_data.description: As Mr Collins lies gravelly injured in the hospital, Wes runs his company. Alex leads the Rangers in a battle against a new powerful robot. But his attitude and leadership style create friction within the group.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Time Force 9x30
episodes_data.description: Wes refuses to acknowledge the idea of destiny and decides to choose his own path in life.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Time Force 9x31
episodes_data.description: Jen and Wes go undercover to investigate a shady gym in Silver Hills.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Time Force 9x32
episodes_data.description: While returning to the Clock Tower with some pizzas, Trip encounters a mysterious knight on a horse. The mysterious knight vanishes into the forest. The knight is after something that is guarded by a dragon. Debut of the Fire Battle Armor.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Time Force 9x33
episodes_data.description: Vypra aligns with Ransik in order to release a super demon to destroy the world. The Time Force Rangers team up with Carter Grayson and the rest of the Lightspeed Rangers to combat this threat.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Time Force 9x34
episodes_data.description: A mutant named Miracon transports the Rangers into a mirror world, where the Rangers must escape from by destroying new and old mutant enemies.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Time Force 9x35
episodes_data.description: Lucas writes a romantic poem about his first love, his first racecar, and during a battle against Ransik's forces, he unknowingly drops it. Nadira picked it up and believed that Lucas has romantic feelings for her, leading Ransik to warn him to treat his daughter right or face his wrath.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Time Force 9x36
episodes_data.description: Circuit's memories are erased by a member of Time Force in the future causing Circuit to doubt his ability to help the Rangers.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Time Force 9x37
episodes_data.description: With Ransik's mutants depleted, the Rangers ponder their past and future as Rangers. Meanwhile, Frax's new robot terrorizes the city, but is destroyed by Eric and the Q-Rex.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Time Force 9x38
episodes_data.description: The Rangers receive a chilling warning from the future as Ransik reprograms Frax and Nadira questions her life as a super villainess.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Time Force 9x39
episodes_data.description: Wes sends the Time Force Rangers back to the future as Frax and his giant robot launch a devastating attack on Silver Hills that no one may survive.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Time Force 9x40
episodes_data.description: Jen and her teammates disobey orders in order to go back in time to rescue Wes and stop Ransik at any cost.
